summary: Iteration 27: CRIF High Mark INDV 2.0 integration testing. Backend: 18/19 tests PASS (1 skipped - HTML content-type; UAT doesn't return HTML). Frontend: All CRIF flows verified - tab visible, prior result loaded, Re-check button works, DOB warning shown, disabled button for no-DOB KYC. Live CRIF UAT API successfully called (Report ID: RADH260509CR385504415).

minor.issue: Response does not include 'checked_by_name' field. GET /result includes it, but POST response omits it. This causes UI to show 'by —' after a Re-check instead of the user's name.

ui_bugs.issue: After clicking 'Re-check', the 'Last checked: ... by —' shows '—' for user name instead of 'Super Admin'. Root cause: POST /api/crif/check response doesn't include checked_by_name, only GET /result does. Fix: Add checked_by_name to POST response in crif.py

issues: UI is clean. DOB warning amber styling is clear. Service statuses are well-labeled. No significant design issues.

action_items: MINOR: Add 'checked_by_name' to POST /api/crif/check/{kyc_id} return dict in crif.py (one-line fix: add 'checked_by_name': check_doc['checked_by_name'] to the return statement at line ~395)
OPTIONAL: DOB stored as DD/MM/YYYY (e.g., '01/01/1987') but _build_crif_xml() only converts YYYY-MM-DD format. CRIF UAT accepts DD/MM/YYYY as-is so no functional break, but worth aligning.
critical_code_review_comments: POST /api/crif/check response (line 395-400) is missing 'checked_by_name' field that GET /result includes. Should add checked_by_name to response for UI consistency.

DOB format: KYC stores as 'DD/MM/YYYY' (01/01/1987), but _build_crif_xml converts only 'YYYY-MM-DD'. The current format passes through unchanged to CRIF XML. CRIF UAT accepts it, but production might be stricter.
crif.py is 448 lines - acceptable size, no split needed.
raw_xml_response is stored up to 100KB per check - could grow large; consider cleanup strategy.
No _id leakage in CRIF responses - projection={'raw_xml_request': 0, '_id': 0} on find_one is correct.

success_rate.backend: 95% — 18/19 tests pass (1 skipped: HTML content-type, expected for UAT)
